text:
Leah: quick spot check of the Model Activity filter bar + grouped rows. Dropping a few accessibility nits.
Sam: thx, quick bullets?
Leah: TL;DR: 1) grouped rows (by model) aren't announced as groups to SRs (missing role=group/aria-roledescription), 2) filter chips lose focus when a typeahead opens (focus jumps), 3) aria-describedby for the results count is missing so screen readers don't get context, 4) color-only sorting indicator has poor contrast and no non-visual indicator.
Priya: can you paste repro + tiny fixes?
Leah: repro 1 (grouping): Console -> Models -> Activity -> group by 'model name'. Screen readers read each row but don't announce group boundaries. Fix: wrap rows in `<div role="group" aria-roledescription="model group" aria-label="Model: {name}">` and add `aria-expanded` for collapsed groups.
Sam: alternative is `aria-labelledby` pointing at the group heading id. Avoid changing table semantics if we maintain keyboard arrow behavior.
Leah: repro 2 (typeahead): open filter -> focus chip -> press Enter -> typeahead pops, focus moves into input but we remove focus styles on the chip which makes keyboard users lose visual focus. Fix: on open, call `chip.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true')` and `input.focus()` but keep a persistent `.focus-ring--persist` class on the chip until the flyout has focusable content.
Priya: include small CSS example.
Leah: repro 3 (results context): top-left shows "23 runs" visually but SRs just read "23" when focused. Add `aria-describedby="results-context"` on the count element and put a visually-hidden span with "Model runs matching filters".
Sam: good. Also add `aria-live="polite"` on the count for dynamic updates but debounce changes to avoid chattiness.
Leah: repro 4 (sort indicator): current sort uses a faint chevron with `opacity:0.4` and changes color on active only. For keyboard/SR users add `aria-sort="ascending|descending"` on the header and a textual sr-only hint: "sorted ascending". For contrast, change chevron color to `#0b66ff` when active and ensure contrast >=4.5:1.
Priya: prioritization?
Leah: I'd say 1) group landmarks + aria-expanded for collapsible groups (med) 2) results context + live debounce (low) 3) chip focus persistence and CSS (low) 4) sort indicator contrast + sr text (low).
Sam: I'll take 1+3, add unit tests for group expand/collapse keyboard behaviour (Space toggles). Priya: can we run a VoiceOver + NVDA pass after PR?
Priya: yes. Sam: add e2e that tabs to a chip, opens typeahead, asserts chip has the persist class and focus is in the input.
a11y-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2276543210 — Findings: Group semantics: WARN, Focus-visible: FAIL (chips), LiveRegion: INFO (count updates un-debounced), Contrast: WARN (sort chevron).
Leah: thanks all — adding notes to backlog: https://redwood-infra/board/1200 and attaching screenshots. :sparkles:
